findings.text: Before that, a free carter who bought his own flour back the day before. Before that, a boy in a loft with a fold of paper sewn into his collar, who had been told when.
findings.issue: Two sentences in a row open with 'Before that,' as a drumbeat to make the recap feel weighty. The reader already has all three items (lines 253-257 and 505-507). sceneVerdicts.F5: No kill. Corley gives way only under leverage (fever line plus sacking). The overseer lies and the trap costs a day. In the lodge, the warming between Sylvanas and Jaina is the plan's intended arc (scene-2 goal), and two open threats undercut it: the army in the way and a road Sylvanas cannot check.
sceneVerdicts.F7: No kill. Every scene ends on an action or an image: line 161 pen, line 235 order, line 385 exit, line 515 slips laid, line 691 the moving brown smear.

audits.povRegister: POV CHARACTER: Sylvanas Windrunner. REGISTER: Ranger-General. Dry, impatient, contemptuous of humans and the Kirin Tor. She reasons like a tracker from ruts, ash, dust and absence, and compares things to her own field (the Pass, troll bands, arrowheads off a field, fletcher's bench, cliff paths, rangers back from a first sweep). Her free indirect asides are profane or sour ('Damn the paper.' 'Sun's sake'). She would not think in sociological or thematic abstractions. REGISTER CONFIDENCE: HIGH.

toolSignalsAudited.text: It was too brown for mist, and it was moving.
